```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

options(warn = -1)
options(message = -1)

devtools::load_all()

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

pm.ls <- load_cache("peakmatrix")
pm <- pm.ls[["matrix"]]
meta <- pm.ls[["metadata"]]

scores(pca(pm), display = "sites", choices = 1:15, scaling = 1) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    consensus_clustering_mk(2, 20, 1000, dist_method = "cor_spearman") %>%
    create_consensus_clustering_report()
```
